rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Policy
content: All Android file I/O MUST go through MiraStorageService (scoped-storage compliant).
FORBID: Direct file path manipulation via ADB commands, app-internal storage access, or bypassing Android security model.
App code: use MiraStorageService APIs (URI/FD based) for read/write/exists/list.
JNI/native: receive and use file descriptors (FD) supplied by MiraStorageService; disallow fopen/open on paths.
ADB commands: NEVER manipulate app-internal storage directly; use app's proper interfaces instead.

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/ADB_Prohibition
content: FORBID these ADB storage manipulation patterns:
- mkdir /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files
- cp /sdcard/* /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files/
- touch /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files/*
- rm /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files/*
- Any direct manipulation of app-internal storage paths
REQUIRED: Use app's file picker, MiraStorageService APIs, or content:// URIs instead.

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/HowTo
content: Refactor pattern:
BEFORE (bad):
- new File(path), FileInputStream(path), Files.readAllBytes(path)
- RandomAccessFile(path,'r'), Paths.get(path)
- '/sdcard/...', Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()
- adb shell 'mkdir /data/user/0/app/files'
- adb shell 'cp /sdcard/file /data/user/0/app/files/'
AFTER (good):
- Kotlin: uri: Uri -> MiraStorage.openReadFd(uri) / MiraStorage.openWriteFd(uri)
- Kotlin: MiraStorage.readBytes(uri) / MiraStorage.writeBytes(uri, data)
- JNI: accept fd (int) or AParcelFileDescriptor; use read(2)/write(2)/mmap on FD only
- ADB: Use app's file picker UI or content:// URIs for file access

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Detection
content: When proposing changes that touch storage or JNI I/O, output a ```triggercheck``` with Categories including: FS, MEDIASTORE, ADB_STORAGE.
DetectedPatterns must list any usages of:
- java.io.File, FileInputStream/OutputStream, RandomAccessFile
- java.nio.file.Files, Paths.get, Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory
- '/sdcard', JNI fopen/open
- adb shell mkdir/cp/touch/rm /data/user/0/com.mira.*/files
- Any direct app-internal storage manipulation via ADB

rules.name: Android/MiraStorage/Test_Strategy
content: Test strategy MUST follow MiraStorage policy:
- Use app's file picker UI for file selection
- Trigger processing through proper app interfaces
- Use content:// URIs for file access
- NEVER manipulate app-internal storage directly via ADB
- Test MiraStorageService APIs, not direct file system access
- Use app's WebView interface or proper Android intents
